generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
The tenderer should be a PWD registered Contractor

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Work done certificate should be issued by competent authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer. Mentioned work Indent number in work done certificate.
The tender of any tenderer who does not accept the conditions contained in the tender document is liable to be rejected. Conditional tenders will not be accepted.

Within 20 days of receipt of the Letter of Acceptance, the successful Tenderer shall deliver to the Employer a Security deposit(FDR) for an amount equivalent to 5% of the Contract price with balance security depost. If the contractor fail to submit the prescribed FDRs and stamp paperwithin time tender will be cancelled.
All tenders are accepted or rejected by the Executive Engineer,PRED.Division,Chitradurga is reserved.
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/Schedule Tribes/CAT-1/CAT-2A category as prescribed in the tender document.
The contractor belonging to the SC/ST/CAT-1/CAT-2A shall be domicile of the state of Karnataka for more than 10 years. Attach Relevant Document issued by Competent Authority.
Contractors upload the original documents and profit and loss statements are must be signed by CA. Mentioned UDIN number is complusory.
Condition mentioned in Bid document KW-1 is accepted.
Accepting or rejecting the tender is reserved by EE
Satisfactory Completion of Any Nature of Work to an extent of 25 percentage of the cost of the work from the past 5-Years. Mentioned work Indent number in work done certificate is compulsory
Rates are Including G.S.T. hence, GST will be paid separately as per prevailing rules.
